stemMd: In a right triangle, an acute angle $\theta$ has opposite side 8 and hypotenuse 17. What is $\cos\theta$?
explanationMd: The adjacent leg is √(17²−8²)=√225=15. Cosine is adjacent divided by hypotenuse, so cos θ=15/17.

distractorRationale.a: This is sin θ, using the opposite side.
distractorRationale.b: This is tangent, using opposite over adjacent rather than adjacent over hypotenuse.
